system.description:
Pugilists are brawlers of swagger. While a monk may dedicate themself to a single focused blow, a pugilist will break their fingers and keep punching with the bloody stump.


Iconic Pugilists

• Carl, Dungeon Crawler Carl

• Rocky Balboa, Rocky

• Hellboy, Hellboy

• Stiffener Medick, Redwall


Playing Pugilist

Pugilists are frontline bruisers. Stay in the frontline, even while at low HP.


Action: Attack (Brawl)

Move: Frontline

Starting Pack: Brawler or Monk


Training: Brawl

features.name: Fisticuffs
features.description:
Your Equipped Brawl Weapons have the Defense and Vicious properties and use a d4 for the damage if it was previously smaller. Further, when you hit an Enemy with a Brawl Weapon, you can either:


• Increase your Brawl Weapons one die size until the start of your Turn.

• Grapple or Shove them if you viably could.

features.name: Rope-a-Dome
features.description: You gain the Check Hook Perk (p. 67) and can also Move 10’ without using Speed before or after you make its attack.

features.name: Moxie
features.description: You have Favor on Saves against being Dazed, Frightened, Grappled, or Restrained.

features.name: Iron Jaw
features.description: The first time each Shift that you are reduced to 0 HP from damage, you can choose to instead be at (MIT + your Level) HP and immediately take an Action and Move up to 10’ without using Speed. At 8th Level, you can use this Ability once per Hour.

features.name: Haymaker
features.description: If you roll a 6 or higher on the damage die of a Brawl attack, the Target is Dazed until the start of your Turn.

features.name: Iron Jaw
features.description: You can use this Ability once per Hour.

features.name: TItle Holder
features.description: You use a d6 for the damage of Equipped Brawl Weapons if the damage was previously smaller.
